edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.population: adults exposed to chlorinated drinking water
edges.mechanism: Disinfection by-products in chlorinated water include mutagenic compounds that contact the urothelium during urine storage, fitting a bladder-cancer pathway.
edges.summary: The anchor for this edge is the 2026 Lim systematic review in BJUI Compass, which suggests that chlorinated disinfection by-products tracks with higher risk or worse outcomes for bladder cancer. Later papers point in much the same direction, so the live uncertainty is usually about effect size or which subgroups carry the signal most strongly.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
